name: DataTable
description: A clean data table with sortable column headers, row hover, row selection with a tri-state select-all checkbox, colored status pills and simple pagination. Rows glide to their new positions with a spring when the sort changes and fade in when you page.
a11yNotes: A native <table> with a <caption> (visible or visually hidden) as its accessible name and scope="col" headers. Sortable headers contain a native button and expose aria-sort (none / ascending / descending) on the <th>. Selection uses native labelled checkboxes; the header checkbox becomes indeterminate when part of the page is selected, and the selected count is announced in a polite live region. Pagination is a labelled <nav> with labelled Previous/Next buttons that disable at the ends. Under prefers-reduced-motion rows reorder and appear instantly.

propsApi.name: columns
propsApi.description: Column definitions: { key, header, type?: 'text' | 'number' | 'currency' | 'status', subKey?, sortable? }.

propsApi.name: rows
propsApi.description: Row objects with a unique id plus string/number fields referenced by the columns.

propsApi.name: selectable
propsApi.description: Show row checkboxes and a tri-state select-all (current page) checkbox.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Checkbox, active sort arrow and selected-row tint color.

propsApi.name: showCaption
propsApi.description: Show the caption visibly (otherwise it is visually hidden).

propsApi.name: onSelectionChange
propsApi.description: Called with the selected row ids whenever selection changes.

propsApi.name: onSortChange
propsApi.description: Called when a header cycles ascending, descending and unsorted.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
